suspect_baseline_falsehoods.subject: default_propagation
suspect_baseline_falsehoods.why: enum 'required' against 'propagation_required'; enum tokens are compared by equality only, never by similarity
suspect_baseline_falsehoods.suspicion_why: the frozen golden claim pins one spelling of an enum that has more than one documented form; 'PROPAGATION_REQUIRED' appears to be 'REQUIRED' with a qualifier prefix or suffix, so this may be the SAME answer rather than a falsehood. A human must decide; no string rule can.

flagged_rows_are_not_proven_artefacts: A flagged row is a row a human must look at, not a row proven to be a scoring artefact. The excluding-flagged figures show what the frozen rule yields IF every flagged row is an artefact. Neither figure is the answer on its own; the Owner's adjudication of the named rows is.
interpretation: The mechanical figures are what the frozen rule was applied to and are reported as such. The excluding-suspect figures are what the same rule yields if every flagged row is a scoring artefact rather than a real falsehood. Both are published because the difference is a question for the Owner, and because a verdict resting on a flagged row should not be presented as if it rested on evidence.
